tips.text: Ignore Reddit threads titled Nukor; nearly all cover the Kuva Nukor, a different Kuva Lich weapon.
Research Detonite Injector first; Nukor research stays locked behind it, so three lab timers run back to back.
Queue the Injector research the moment the Chem Lab is ready and farm the build materials while it runs.
Take Detonite Injectors from Grineer Invasion rewards to skip crafting them and the Control Modules they need.
Nobody complains about the farm itself; the wait is the lab timers.
